flow.name: 10 · Base64 encode + SHA-256 hash pipeline
flow.notes: Webhook → Base64-encode the body → SHA-256 hash the body → SHA-256 hash the Base64 (to prove chained var reads work) → post all three values. Tests Base64 ENCODE, Hash with SHA-256, and var-chaining magic text. Trigger: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8821/hook/crypto --data 'hello world'. Cross-check on desktop: printf 'hello world' | base64  and  printf 'hello world' | sha256sum.
